type: 0-1 packing (independent record set) + exact rational LP dual
scope: lower bound on cover size over the 499 supplied candidates only.
packing_property: no single candidate covers two records of this set (independently checkable against finite_cover_incidence.json)

exact_rational_dual.note: weights w_j on records; every candidate has sum_{j in covered} w_j <= 1.

argument: |cover| >= packing_size because each candidate covers at most one packing record; this is pure counting, no solver needed.
